name: EMA + RSI + VWAP Targets

conditions: (close > ema and close > vwap and rsi > rsiBuyLevel) and not (close > ema and close > vwap and rsi > rsiBuyLevel)[1]
(close < ema and close < vwap and rsi < rsiSellLevel) and not (close < ema and close < vwap and rsi < rsiSellLevel)[1]

notes: EMA + VWAP trend filter with an RSI level gate; enters on the first bar the compound condition flips true. ema/rsi bindings would auto-derive but the script names them plainly; kept explicit for clarity.
